## Problem

Describe one concrete governance failure or missing capability.

## Proposed rule

State the proposed invariant, transition, evidence requirement, or lifecycle change precisely.

## Examples

Provide at least one state that should pass and one that should fail.

## Affected surfaces

List specification sections, schemas, CLI commands, tests, hooks, adapters, CI, templates, and migration guidance that would need changes.

## Risks and alternatives

Identify compatibility costs, enforcement gaps, and simpler alternatives considered.
